title: Conditional κ = 7.45513573133379·10⁻⁴: early restorations and terminal sinks on the gen5 kernel word, with #233's complex word as supplier (+0.107% over #290)
body:
# Conditional κ = 7.45513573133379·10⁻⁴: early restorations and terminal sinks on the gen5 kernel word, with #233's complex word as supplier (+0.107% over #290)

One self-contained package, `research/five-stage-gen5-restorations-sinks/`, with its own workflow. No existing file is changed.

**κ = 745513573133379/10¹⁸ = 7.45513573133379·10⁻⁴**: +0.1073% over #290's 7.44714499357628·10⁻⁴, above the rungs stacked on #290 (#291–#293, best 7.44729·10⁻⁴), and +0.187% over #287. Bit coarse 7.46070·10⁻⁴, complex coarse 7.54736·10⁻⁴; the bit side binds with a 1.16% margin.

## What it is

The #290 package (#285's gen5 word, #287's 904-gate descent and 220 target squares, our 450 collective kernel entries) with three changes, each a stage or input of the same Python pipeline, each priced on the whole word (the φ-ledger model predicted every κ below exactly before the stage was built):

| step | mechanism (credited) | census on gen5 | κ |
|---|---|---|---|
| #290 | — | — | 7.44714499357628·10⁻⁴ |
| complex supplier → #233's word | #233/#256 (ours), Lean-checked in jacobalansussman/wht-power-saving-lean#2 | gcert/1 certificate replaces #193's | unchanged (bit binds), complex cap 7.47455 → **7.54736·10⁻⁴** |
| **440 early helper restorations** | #280 (utcorvusvolat-dotcom), endpoint-aware banking as in #283 (Dugongue) | at the first cleanup ADD (record 601,737): 440 rank-20-entrance helpers whose single remaining incidence is a −= b, with entrance, both frames and a nondegenerate rank-23 join | 7.45272862652714·10⁻⁴ (+0.075%) |
| **8 terminal sinks** | #283 (Dugongue; source527 lineage) | 16 match the shape; 8 whose targets are not read by #287's squares are legal (the other 8 would need a downward move) | **7.45513573133379·10⁻⁴** (+0.032%) |

The complex swap does not change κ by itself; it keeps the restorations' and sinks' gains (+0.107% together) from being capped by #193's complex supplier, which sits only 0.29% above #290's bit side.

## Checks

`python3 -B verify.py` runs twelve fresh stages — virtual, raw, bit (with #287's stages), kernel, **restore**, **sink**, scalar, primes, banks, complex, math, finite — with twelve omitted-stage negative controls:

* restore: 1,768,348 crossed-gate commutation checks; all 19,406 columns forward and inverse; omission control rejected (440 wrong rows); both reflected ledgers; completion P_σ + I − P_E, and the geometry stage rejects the old I − P_σ residual;
* sink: all 19,398 remaining columns forward and inverse; three omission controls rejected (32 / 24 / 24 wrong rows); each removed helper frees exactly 24 rank; the 4,400 deficit re-checked at R = 15,878;
* banks: charts built on (E ∩ σ⊥ | σ | E⊥), 985 charts (440 new), max 576 factors; literal stock 1,244,515 → 1,242,935; role census checked against the removed roles;
* complex: #233's gcert/1 program through the package's complex stage unchanged in logic (labels, splice, scalars, precision guard below 2⁴⁸; all complex mutation controls rejected), complex coarse 754736418878859/10¹⁸ pinned at the 10⁻¹⁸ grid;
* every changed literal is a recomputed pin in `expected/kernel-pins.json` (`pins.py` now also refuses one name with two values).

## Verify

    python -m pip install -r research/five-stage-gen5-restorations-sinks/requirements.txt    # sympy 1.14.0
    python3 -B research/five-stage-gen5-restorations-sinks/verify.py --output /tmp/gen5-rs-verification   # about 5 minutes; not under -I

Prints `PASS_IMMUTABLE_GEN5_KERNEL_RESTORE_SINK_FIVE_STAGE_BANKED_CONSTRUCTION`. The workflow runs it and #285's generator check on Ubuntu.

## Scope and limits

* Conditional finite construction under the retained public all-size hypotheses (no Lean certificate for the bit side). #285, #287 and #290 are open; their word and stages are inherited.
* Not composed: #280's transported dirty entrances (on gen5, 1,911 of the 1,967 untouched plain helpers have a target read by a square, leaving ≈ +0.003%); 354 restoration candidates whose join is the full frame; single-target sinks (geometrically illegal on this word); the retiming rungs #291/#292/#293 on #290 (compatible in principle, not rebound here).

## Credits

Prepared by Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial Anthropic Claude assistance. Apache-2.0; lineage in `NOTICE.md`. The early-restoration mechanism is utcorvusvolat-dotcom's (#280); the terminal sinks and endpoint-aware banking are Dugongue's (#283); the gen5 word is DreamingOfClouds' (#285); the descent and target stages are rohanarun's (#287); the kernel stage and the complex word are ours (#290, #233/#256), on Dugongue's (#254/#259/#272) and eumemic's (#268) mechanisms and the source527 five-stage lineage, hcg890's #234 layout and Jacob Sussman's construction.
